alex: FYI hit a puzzler while trying to make the JS SDK friendly for Node + Next Edge + Cloudflare. Local tests (CJS + ESM) pass but our edge example crashes with `TypeError: sdk.default is not a function`.

sara: likely ESM/CJS interop. are consumers using default import? our ESM build exports named functions only.

alex: yes, example does `import SDK from 'redwood-sdk'` because older samples used default. rollup output has only `export const createClient`. CJS has module.exports.default for compat.

li: two fixes: 1) make ESM bundle export a default as well (rollup `export default createClient`), 2) add an explicit worker/edge subpath in package.json `exports` so edge bundlers pick an ESM-only entry. e.g. "./edge": { "import": "./dist/esm/edge.js", "types": "./dist/types/edge.d.ts" }.

mike: also watch retries in edge: our retry helper retries requests with a ReadableStream body and the second attempt fails because the stream is drained. Node clones ok, workers not.

alex: current helper: async function retryFetch(input, init) { for (let i=0;i<2;i++){ const r = await fetch(input, init); if (r.ok) return r; } throw new Error('failed'); } — we pass init.body from callers.

sara: buffer bodies for retries or accept a factory: `retryFetch(() => ({ body: createBody() }))`. for minimal perf hit, only buffer when body is a stream and environment lacks cloning. document patterns in README.

li: small typing note: include `types` inside each export subpath so TS resolves correct declarations for `import 'redwood-sdk/edge'`. consider `typesVersions` for older TS consumers.

mike: CI/Jest pain: jest chokes on mixed ESM/CJS in node_modules. our workaround: publish CJS under dist/cjs and add a small `jest` stanza or CI step that transpiles ESM. also add smoke tests in examples/edge to run on Vercel/CF.

alex: plan: 1) add `./edge` export + edge build that ensures default export, 2) add buffering/factory for retry bodies, 3) update examples/README and add CI smoke on edge examples, 4) include types in exports. will send PR with repro.

devx-bot: created issue DEVX-1100: "sdk: edge subpath + default export parity + retry-safe bodies" assigned to @alex.
